title: A Conway Marriage Story
text: All right, so I'm familiar with some of the differences of opinion that you've had publicly. I want to know what you love about each other. So why don't you two read your lists? George, would you like to start? Okay. Go ahead, babe. What I love about Kellyanne. She worked so hard for her boss, even though I hate his guts. Hey, look, Steve, I actually have been to the border. Kellyanne. The Democrats are actually lying. The children are not drinking from toilets because they actually did not unpack toilets. Kellyanne, we are out of time. They just used the corner. Okay, let's cut our mic. I don't know. Thank you. What I love about George, he always leaves his coffee mugs around. He actually always tells me what he thinks about me to my face. George? George? Are you mad at me? Oh, uh, no, no, no. George, am I a demon? Oh, uh, from what? I can't tell. I don't even... I can't see in here. It's kind of dark and loud. I think I'm going through a tunnel. George Conway, do not sub-tweet me at the dinner table, please. We find ways to spend time together. I love our little pet names for each other. Hey, loser. Hey, wolf. We find ways to keep in touch during the workday. I love how my boss called him a stone-cold loser and husband from hell. Sorry, that's not something George did, but I love it. I love when she does poems on TV. I love that he loves to read. The DSM to find out what's wrong with my boss. Narcissist. There it is. I love that when Ann Coulter set us up, she thought, these two are perfect for each other. I love that we agree on the big stuff, like small government and no food for poor. Get a job! Oh! And I know I'm not supposed to, but I even love our fights. I feel bad for you! You are the one who introduced us, George! I didn't know he'd be president! You're not Blue Jack, George! Aah! Jesus! Gerald Nadler has just announced articles of impeachment. Okay, so, do you have what you need for your piece? Piece? Oh, um, I'm not a reporter. I'm a therapist. Oh, this isn't for, like, a book? Oh, no. What you say doesn't leave this room. Then why are we doing this? We're gonna go. We have to go fight on The View. Hon, I gotta be done by 5 for dinner with Kathy Griffin. Don't get me all hot. Save it for the show.
